valor: In southern Venezuela, three generations of the Pemón people fight for the return of their ancestral grandmother, Kowai Kueka. Her spirit is embodied in a red jasper stone, removed and taken to Germany without the community's consent for an art installation. The guardians of memory set out on a journey of resistance against memoricide.
